source_note: Medicare Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) and related CMS policy status for biosimilar molecule families tracked by PurpleGap. All dates and sources verified as of 2026-11-18. Update this file as policies evolve.

explanation.NEGOTIATED: Medicare Drug Price Negotiation: a maximum fair price (MFP) is in effect. Products may be deselected if a biosimilar is bona fide marketed, ending the negotiated price on the specified date.
explanation.SELECTED_2028: Selected for Medicare Drug Price Negotiation with prices starting 2028-01-01. This is the first cycle including Part B drugs. Biosimilar makers can request delay; the deadline for the next cycle is 2026-12-10. The 2028 list includes: Trulicity, Orencia (abatacept), Cosentyx (secukinumab), Entyvio (vedolizumab), Botox, Xolair (omalizumab), Cimzia (certolizumab pegol). None of these are currently tracked by PurpleGap.
explanation.ASP_PLUS_8: Temporary Part B add-on: ASP + 8% of reference product ASP instead of 6%. Qualifying biosimilars paid on ASP as of 2022-09-30 get it from 2022-10-01 to 2027-09-30. Newer qualifying biosimilars first paid on ASP between 2022-10-01 and 2027-12-31 get 5 years from their first ASP quarter.
explanation.GLOBE_EXCLUDED_WITH_BIOSIMILAR: CMS GLOBE model (starting 2027-01-01) applies to Part B physician-administered drugs. CMS GLOBE excludes reference biologics once a US biosimilar is marketed. This is an informational flag for Part B reference products with marketed biosimilars.

tags.title: Medicare Negotiated Price In Effect
tags.detail: 2026 Maximum Fair Price: $2,355 per 30-day supply, effective 2026-01-01. Not deselected.
tags.timing_note: Negotiated price creates strong incentive for immediate biosimilar conversion.

tags.title: Medicare Negotiated Price Ending Jan 1, 2027
tags.detail: 2026 Maximum Fair Price: $4,695, effective 2026-01-01. DESELECTED effective 2027-01-01 because a biosimilar is bona fide marketed. Negotiated price applies only through 2026-12-31.
tags.timing_note: Critical conversion window: convert remaining Stelara prescribers before and immediately after Jan 1, 2027 deselection.

tags.title: GLOBE Model: Biosimilar Marketed (Part B)

tags.timing_note: Part B reference biologic excluded from GLOBE international-benchmark rebates. Biosimilar conversion reduces Part B costs.

key_dates.label: Biosimilar Delay Request Deadline
key_dates.description: Deadline for biosimilar makers to request delay for 2028 negotiation cycle (first Part B cycle).

key_dates.label: Stelara Negotiated Price Ends
key_dates.description: Stelara (ustekinumab) deselected from negotiation program; negotiated price ($4,695 MFP) ends.

key_dates.label: GLOBE Model Starts & Stelara Deselection
key_dates.description: CMS GLOBE model begins (international-benchmark rebates; reference biologics with marketed biosimilars excluded). Stelara negotiated price no longer applies.

key_dates.label: First ASP+8% Expirations
key_dates.description: First wave of temporary Part B ASP+8% add-ons expire for qualifying biosimilars paid on ASP as of 2022-09-30.

key_dates.label: 2028 Negotiated Prices Begin (Part B)
key_dates.description: Medicare negotiated prices take effect for 2028 selected drugs, including first Part B drugs (e.g., Remicade/infliximab if not delayed).

asp_plus_8_note: ASP+8% (vs ASP+6%) is a per-biosimilar product benefit, not a family-level tag. Implementation requires first-ASP-quarter data per biosimilar product, which is not currently in the data model. To add: extend product model with firstAspQuarter, compute start/end dates, and tag individual biosimilar products.
notes: Only families actually tracked by PurpleGap are tagged.
GLOBE_EXCLUDED_WITH_BIOSIMILAR applies only to Part B physician-administered drugs. GLOBE does not apply to Part D self-administered drugs like Humira.
